newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Oct gold/forex reserves 10.28 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.African Oct gold/forex reserves 10.28 bln rand.

text.p: South Africa's combined gold and foreign exchange reserves rose 241.5 million rand in October to 10.28 billion rand from September's 10.04 billion rand, when they fell 35.68 million rand, Reserve Bank figures show.
The central bank also said it had repaid fully by October 31 foreign credit lines amounting to 612 million rand used during September.
Economists polled by Reuters had forecast October reserves at 9.6 billion rand, with the range 9.0 to 10.4 billion rand.
